name: HireRight
summary: HireRight sells quoted background screening. Its Connect API page describes linking with applicant tracking platforms, gathering candidates' permission and running criminal record screenings, and the only call to action is a pricing request. We could confirm little more from its public pages.

facts.text: The HireRight Connect API page describes three capabilities: linking with applicant tracking platforms, gathering candidates' permission, and running background screenings for criminal records.
The Connect API page publishes no price and offers only a request for pricing.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: No prices are published. Buyers request pricing
